## 3. Scientific question

Primary question:

> If the selected F-04 classical `CutComparability` provider is removed while
> the accepted Dedekind carrier, identity, order relation, operations, and all
> other logical providers remain fixed, which accepted R and downstream C
> results survive, and which depend specifically on disjunctive totality?

Secondary question:

> Can the same accepted `LowerCut / CutEquiv / RBOMA` carrier recover the same
> disjunctive totality theorem without F-04 and without introducing a replacement
> classical/Choice principle or a changed representation contract?

The secondary question may legitimately answer **no / not recovered**. The
experiment is not forced to preserve the accepted total-order contract to count
as scientifically successful.

## 5. Logical-control boundary

The accepted R commitment ledger contains other localized classical providers:

```text
F-05  Classical.em in finite cut-membership search / fine bracketing
F-06  Classical.byContradiction in positive representative extraction
F-07  Classical.byContradiction / Classical.em in strict rational density
```

These are **controls**, not targets.

Therefore the experiment must distinguish:

```text
F04_FREE
  no dependency on cutComparability_classical or rLE_total_classical

F04_DEPENDENT
  direct or transitive dependency on one of those declarations

OTHER_CLASSICAL_ONLY
  no F-04 dependency, but another accepted localized classical provider remains

FULLY_CONSTRUCTIVE_WITHIN_MEASURED_CLOSURE
  no Classical.* dependency in the measured closure
```

Removing F-04 must never be described as making all accepted R constructive.

## 13. Gate D — same-carrier no-F-04 totality recovery attempt

Attempt to recover the accepted disjunctive totality theorem while preserving:

```text
same LowerCut definition
same CutEquiv
same RBOMA
same rLE
no new logical principle
no selected F-04 provider
no abstract CutComparability assumption in the final recovered theorem
```

Allowed Study outcomes:

```text
RECOVERED_SAME_CARRIER
NOT_RECOVERED_WITH_CURRENT_CUT_INTERFACE
REQUIRES_LOCATEDNESS_OR_REPRESENTATION_STRENGTHENING
REQUIRES_ACCEPTANCE_ORDER_WEAKENING
```

If a candidate proof requires adding a locatedness field to `LowerCut`, changing
its representation class, changing `CutEquiv`, or weakening the accepted order
statement, STOP that implementation path. Record it as a finding requiring a
separate experiment/acceptance decision.

No theorem-proving failure may be converted into an unsupported impossibility
claim. `NOT_RECOVERED` means exactly that no valid proof was obtained within the
frozen interface and allowed logical boundary.

## 18. Success criteria

### 18.1 Minimum scientific PASS

`ST2-EXP-004` may be classified PASS if it establishes, with exact kernel and
dependency evidence:

```text
which R roots survive without F-04;
which R roots depend on F-04;
which downstream C Claim roots survive without orderTotal;
which C roots fail specifically because orderTotal was removed;
that F-05/F-06/F-07 remain separately visible controls;
that no replacement classical/Choice principle was hidden;
that accepted Q/R/C sources/manifests remain unchanged.
```

Full accepted-totality recovery is not required.

### 18.2 Stronger optional result

Claim `FULL SAME-CARRIER TOTALITY RECOVERY` only if Lean proves the same accepted
conclusion:

```text
∀ x y : RBOMA, rLE x y ∨ rLE y x
```

from the unchanged frozen carrier/order interface with:

```text
no cutComparability_classical
no rLE_total_classical
no abstract CutComparability assumption
no Classical.em / byContradiction / choose
no new axiom
```

Anything weaker must use the corresponding weaker classification.
